payload.name: Rupam Ghosal
payload.notes:
I’m currently a PhD Research Scholar at BIT Mesra working in AI, Robotics, and Healthcare-focused systems. Alongside research, I have experience as a STEM educator and robotics trainer, where I conducted hands-on workshops on Arduino, IoT, AI/ML, automation, and student innovation projects.

What excites me about Get Set Learn is the focus on making future-ready learning engaging and practical for students. I enjoy building interactive learning experiences that combine creativity, problem-solving, and technology, and I would love the opportunity to contribute to your STEM programs and bootcamps.
